text.jp:
……よくここがわかったね。
アンタもしつこいよ、守り人さん。
text.official_en: Yer a persistent one, aren’t ya, Warden? Gotta commend ya for figurin’ out that I was here, though.
text.real_en:
...So you found this place.
You're a persistent one, Warden.

text.jp:
……メルセデス。
私は、「飛空艇に負けた」とは思っていませんよ。
text.official_en: My point is: I do not believe that ships ever “lost” to airships, Mercedes.

text.jp:
……守り人さんの言う通りだ。
略奪なんかしなくても仲間たちを食わせられるなら、
それが一番いいに決まってる。
text.official_en: Yer right, Warden. If we can make a livin’ without the plunderin’, that’d be a huge win for us.
text.real_en:
...You're right, Warden.
If we can feed our crew without looting,
that's obviously the best way.

text.jp:
……船の仕事が飛空艇なんかに取られるのを、
ただ、指を咥えて見ていただけのくせに！
どうしていまさら！
text.official_en: Why now!? When the airships came in and robbed honest, hard-working sailors of their livelihoods, ya all just looked on WITH YA THUMBS UP YA—
text.real_en: When airships took away our work, all you did was stand by and watch! Why come to us now?!

text.jp:
ええ、飛空艇も万能ではありません。
海には海の戦い方があるはずです。
text.official_en: Yes, I have ample evidence to back my claim. Airships are not the be-all and end-all of transportation, and as I have stated, seafaring has its own advantages.
text.real_en: That's right. Airships aren't all-powerful. There must be ways for ships to hold their own at sea.

text.jp:
ええ。
あなた方、船乗りの話を聞きました。
あなたの「生きるため」という言葉の意味も。
text.official_en: I do. I heard about the predicament you and your former sailors face, and of the meaning behind your words of “surviving” through piracy.
text.real_en: Yes. I've heard what happened to you sailors, and I understand what you meant when you said you were doing this to survive.

text.jp:
ええ。
そして、これは私の償いでもあります。
text.official_en: Yes, penance. For me, as well as you and your men.
text.real_en: Yes. And it's a way for me to make amends, too.

text.jp:
お利口さんが、知ったような口をきく。
これまで、何もしてくれなかったくせに……
text.official_en: What’s a goody two-shoes like ya know about <text style="italic">us</>, eh? After ya did absolutely jack squat for us all this time?
text.real_en: Listen to the little know-it-all, talking as if you understand us... You haven't done a thing for us until now...

text.jp: お前……
text.official_en: You son of a gun...
text.real_en: You...

text.jp: お前……本気なのか。
text.official_en: Yer...serious...ain’t ya?

text.jp:
この先、ディルマギアが飛空艇を独占しようとも、
たとえ、世界情勢が変わろうとも……
誇りを捨てなければ、オルデリオンの海運は蘇る。
text.official_en: And even if Dilmagia attempts to monopolize airships or the way the world is changes, as long as we have faith and pride in our nation, Olderion’s maritime trade will thrive once again.
text.real_en: Even if Dilmagia monopolizes airships and the world changes, Olderion's maritime trade will recover as long as we don't abandon our pride.

text.jp:
それに、アンタの展望……
たったいま、口から出まかせで言ったわけじゃ
ないんだろう？
text.official_en: Yer awfully confident, but ya also seem like a smart sort. Ya got proof to back up what ya said about ships makin’ a comeback, don’t ya?
text.real_en: And that future you talked about... you didn't just make it up on the spot, did you?

text.jp:
それに、先人たちが紡いできた、
豊富な航路や航海術がオルデリオンにはあります。
text.official_en: Furthermore, Olderion is home to a wealth of knowledge of seaways and marine navigation techniques accumulated by generations of sailors.

text.jp:
だが、気に入った！
そこまで期待されているんだ。
やってみせるしかないよな。
text.official_en: But, ya sure as hell put a smile on this ol’ seadog’s mug! If ya believe in us that much, then we gotta pay ya back in kind.
text.real_en: But I like it! You've got that much faith in us. I guess we've got to give it a try.

text.jp: ですが、船には船の役割があると私は思う。
text.official_en: And another thing, if I may. There are things <text style="italic">only ships</> can do.
text.real_en: But I believe ships have a role of their own.

text.jp: どういう意味だ？
text.official_en: What do you mean?

text.jp: はい。
text.official_en: Yes.

text.jp:
はい。あなた方の事情は調べさせていただきました。
今回はあなたたちに、償いの機会を持ってきたんです。
text.official_en: Yes, I understand that now—and as such, I come offering a chance for penance.
text.real_en: Yes. I've looked into your circumstances. This time, I've come to offer you a chance to make amends.

text.jp:
はんッ！
どうしてアタイらが
そんな無益なことをしなくちゃいけないんだ？
text.official_en: And why the <text style="italic">hell</> would we do somethin’ that wouldn’t make a single flubbin’ gil for us!?
text.real_en: Hah! Why would we do something so pointless?

text.jp: ふっ……言うじゃねえか。
text.official_en: Heh...ya talk awfully big, Warden...

text.jp:
もちろん。対価はお支払いいたします。
真面目に働くというなら、守り人の権限において
最低限の生活ができるように保障します。
text.official_en: If you promise to keep your nose clean, by my authority as a Warden, I will ensure that you and your men will be paid a livable sum during your period of penance.
text.real_en: Of course, I'll pay you for it. Under my authority as a Warden, I can guarantee you a basic livelihood if you're willing to work honestly.

text.jp:
わかった。
それまでに償いをしておく。
もう一度、船乗りの誇りを取り戻すためにね。
text.official_en: Ya got yerself a deal, Warden. We’ll make up for what we’ve done—it’s a small price to pay to get our dignity back as sailors.

text.jp:
アタイらを雇うってことか？
守り人さん、アンタ正気かい？
text.official_en: Ha! So you’d have us workin’ for ya? Ya realize what yer suggestin’, Warden?
text.real_en:
You wanna hire us?
Warden, have you lost your mind?

text.jp:
オルデリオンが世界の中心……とまでは言いませんが、
どこの国にも寄らない中立国として、
海の中心に居続けることは揺らぎません。
text.official_en: While I would not be so overly ambitious as to say Olderion is the center of the world... I will certainly say that it will continue to be a neutral realm at the center of the seas.

text.jp:
今私は大きな仕事の最中ですが……
それを終えたら、オルデリオンの船ここにありと、
世界に示しましょう。
text.official_en: I am currently indisposed on a critical mission... But when that matter is settled, I will once again bring the greatness of Olderion’s ships to the attention of the world.
text.real_en: I'm in the middle of an important task right now, but once it's done, we'll show the world what Olderion's ships can do.

text.jp:
何を言われようが海賊はやめない。
こっちは生きるためにやってるんだ。
text.official_en: No amount of finger-waggin’ is gonna convince me to give up our livelihood. I told ya, we’re doin’ everything we can to survive.
text.real_en: Say what you want. I'm not giving up piracy. We're doing it to survive.

text.jp: 償い……？
text.official_en: “Penance”?

text.jp:
必ず、数年のうちに盛り返すと信じています。
その時に力を貸してもらうためにも、
いまは罪を償ってください。
text.official_en: Again, I believe that in a few years’ time we will see an efflorescence of maritime trade, and we will need you and your men. But until then, you will need to atone for your crimes.
text.real_en: I believe Olderion's maritime trade will recover within a few years. We'll need your help then, so please make amends for your crimes in the meantime.

text.jp:
敵対しているばかりでは、物事は解決しません。
これは私の軍師としての考えです。
text.official_en: No good can come from us fighting; the greatest victory is that which requires no battle. That is one of my guiding principles as a strategist.
text.real_en: We won't solve anything if all we do is fight each other. That's how I see it as a strategist.

text.jp:
正直、これまで手が回らなかったことは
私の落ち度です。申し訳ございません。
text.official_en: Again, I accept all the blame for not addressing the sailors’ situation up to this point. And for that, I apologize from the bottom of my heart.
text.real_en: To be frank, it's my fault I couldn't attend to this until now. I'm sorry.

text.jp:
知ってるだろ？
波が高い方が燃えるってものさ。
アタイら船乗りってのはな。
text.official_en: Ah, keep yer luck wishing, Warden. We’re sailors—the bigger the wave, the better!
text.real_en: You know us sailors. The higher the waves, the more fired up we get.

text.jp:
簡単な道ではないでしょうが
その時はよろしくお願いします。
text.official_en: It will not be an easy road to restoration, but when the time comes, I’ll be counting on you and your men. Until then, I wish you the best of luck.
text.real_en: It won't be easy, but when that time comes, I'm counting on you.

text.jp:
重い積荷を一度に多く運べ、
燃料も飛空艇ほどかからない。
text.official_en: They can haul a prodigious amount of cargo per single voyage, and they are far more energy efficient than airships.
text.real_en: Ships can carry large, heavy loads at once, and they don't use nearly as much fuel as airships.

text.jp:
頼みがあります。
水神様が暴走した影響で、近海の魔物が増えています。
それを駆除してくれませんか？
text.official_en: I have a request to make. Leviathan’s frenzy has resulted in an increase in monsters running amok in the seas surrounding Olderion. May I ask you and your men to exterminate them?
text.real_en:
I have a request. The God of Water’s rampage
has caused more monsters to appear in nearby seas.
Could you get rid of them?
